findings.title: Name doesn't match any texture type
findings.what: "ComfyUI_00042_" doesn't match the name of any texture type.
findings.why: Unity's import presets choose a file's settings by its name, so a file named outside these patterns gets the wrong import settings without anyone noticing.
findings.how: Rename the file so its name, without the extension, matches one of these (* stands for any text): T_*_N (Normal map), T_* (Texture).

findings.title: Not sRGB
findings.what: It has the colour profile "Display P3" embedded, not sRGB.
findings.why: Unity ignores embedded colour profiles and treats every texture as sRGB, so its colours in the game won't match what you saw in Photoshop.
findings.how: Convert it to sRGB: in Photoshop, Edit > Convert to Profile, with the destination sRGB IEC61966-2.1. Then save it again.
